params.requestedFunds: Amount of OBS tokens requested (18 decimals)

The messageHash MUST be computed as:       keccak256(abi.encodePacked(DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, proposalId, milestoneIndex, trancheAmount, recipient, deadline, nonce)) PQC VERIFICATION: Delegates to IObscuraToken.verifyHybridSignature() which MUST       implement actual Dilithium + Ed25519 verification via precompile/external verifier. params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which this authorization expires
params.milestoneIndex: The milestone index being released (1, 2, or 3)
params.proposalId: The executed proposal to release funds for
params.recipient: The recipient address (must match proposal recipient)
params.trancheAmount: The amount of OBS to release (must match requestedFunds / 3)

params._roomieRobotRelayer: The address of the robot relayer (MCU public key)

params.support: True for yes, false for no

checkAndUnlockBondingCurveFunds().notice: Checks the Obscura token contract to see if 5 Billion DAI has been raised on the bonding curve.         Once unlocked, remains unlocked permanently.

createProposal(string,uint256,address,by.notice: Creates a proposal. Requires holding at least 50 LP tokens issued for the current month.         Snapshots voting month and proposer's LP weight at creation time to prevent         voting power disappearance during active proposal.

executeProposal(uint256).notice: Executes a successful proposal once quorum (100 LP) and majority are reached,         provided the 5 Billion DAI bonding curve goal has unlocked the vault.

getCurrentMonthId().notice: Returns the current month ID based on fixed 30-day epochs from genesis.         Using fixed 30-day months ensures deterministic, predictable expiration.

getMonthId(uint256).notice: Returns the month ID for a given timestamp.

getVaultBalance().notice: Returns the current vault OBS balance (accounting + actual balance).

getVotingWeight(address,uint256).notice: Returns the LP voting weight for an account in a specific month.         Returns 0 if month has expired.

isMonthActive(uint256).notice: Checks if a given month ID is the current or a future month (not expired).

issueMonthlyLp().notice: Issues 100 LP tokens to all members for the current month.         Can be called by anyone (permissionless) to trigger monthly issuance.         Previous month's LP tokens automatically expire (not accessible via getCurrentMonthId).

joinDAO().notice: Allows any address to join the DAO as a member.         Members receive 100 LP tokens automatically each month via issueMonthlyLp.

receiveObsTokens(uint256).notice: Receives OBS tokens into the DAO vault.         Updates internal vault accounting.

revokeRelayerPermissionAndLock().notice: Revokes updating permissions to make the robot relayer mapping permanently immutable.         Can only be called once by the admin.

roomieRobotExecuteApprovedProposal(uint2.notice: Strictly enforced by the Roomie Robot hardware MCU and biometric PQC signatures.         Mathematically times out fund releases to exactly once every 2 months (60 days) per tranche,         protecting token price stability and preventing liquidity dumps.

setMonthlyLpBalance(address,uint256,uint.notice: Admin function to manually set LP balance for a specific account and month.         Used for testing or exceptional circumstances.

setupRoomieRobotAndLock(address).notice: Sets up or updates the Roomie Robot MCU relayer address/public key.         Can be updated when hardware arrives, and permanently locked later.

timeoutProposal(uint256).notice: Allows marking a proposal as timed out if voting period ended without execution.         Can be called by anyone after voting period ends if proposal not executed.

vote(uint256,bool).notice: 1:1 voting using LP tokens from the proposal's voting month (snapshot at creation).         Prevents voting power disappearance during active proposal.
